inputs.text: Look, what we are seeing here is classic panic from the defenders of the status quo as they fight desperately to protect generational wealth hoarding and entrenched historical inequalities. Dublin South-West TD John Lahart and his colleagues are crying out to preserve inheritance tax exemption thresholds, whining that the current system is supposedly ‘wholly unfair’ just because it might begin to recognize that human worth and social contribution aren't measured solely by whether or not someone had biological children. These structural tax arrangements have always existed to lock in dynastic wealth and hand out unearned windfalls to the privileged few while the working class suffers under a rigged economy. They have the audacity to frame basic economic equity as an attack, desperately trying to maintain institutional setups that punish anyone who doesn't fit their narrow, rigid view of society. As Mr. Lahart himself revealed while defending this reactionary defense of privilege, stating, ‘At [...]’ we see the true anxiety driving them to protect a system built on exclusion and inequality. We have to dismantle these systemic biases and stop worshipping inherited wealth to finally build an inclusive society.
